prompt: Use case: compositing. Create ONE new cohesive visual novel living-room background fusing the two supplied references. Image 1 supplies modern furniture: comfortable cream fabric sofa with blue and muted coral cushions, flat-screen television on a warm wood media cabinet and discreet game controllers. Image 2 supplies traditional Japanese architecture and setting: tatami mats edged in dark blue, exposed honey-colored wood posts and ceiling beams, cream plaster, shoji sliding screens, an engawa wood veranda and sunny turquoise sea view, a tokonoma alcove with a wave-art hanging scroll and small bonsai, blue-white tea ceramics, purple hydrangeas and woven baskets. Design a believable unified lived-in coastal Japanese home, not a split-screen collage. Traditional room is the architectural base, with broad open shoji doors to the sea on the RIGHT; on LEFT a low wooden TV cabinet with a dark switched-off modern television, alongside a small traditional display alcove. Cream sofa on the back-left faces the television at a plausible angle, seating arranged naturally around one low dark wooden coffee/tea table on tatami near center, with blue-white teapot and cups and a single unobtrusive game controller, two burgundy zabuton floor cushions at the table opposite the sofa. Generous visible tatami foreground for character overlays. The sofa and TV should both be clearly visible and substantial; traditional features should be unmistakable and balanced with them. Kitchen is now a separate background, so do not show kitchen appliances or a dining kitchen in this new living room; close rear walls with shoji/fusuma and the tokonoma instead. Consistent scale, coherent perspective and realistic furniture placement. Same polished detailed hand-painted anime game background style as both references, fine clean outlines, warm wood and cream palette, blue accents, rich green plants, bright inviting midday sunlight from the right, soft natural shadows. Eye-level wide landscape composition, 1672x941, full-bleed opaque background. Empty room, no people or animals, no text, no labels, no watermarks.
